_comment: USD prices used for jobs.meta cost accounting. Checked against the OpenAI pricing page on 2026-09-06, gpt-5.6-luna on 2026-09-16, Deepgram nova-3 (pay-as-you-go batch) on 2026-09-17. per_minute for STT models, per 1M tokens for LLMs. supports_temperature: false = the model accepts only its default temperature, llm-call then omits the parameter; absent = sent as usual. Deepgram is billed at the list price even while the starter credit pays for it: a zero price would move the cost of a job and the size of the daily budget on the day the credit ends.
